description:
Who We Are

Imprint is on a mission to make every customer a regular.

You know how it feels when you walk into your favorite coffee shop and they know your name and start prepping your usual? Imprint makes it possible for the largest brands to create that experience at scale.

We bring payments, loyalty, and customer intelligence together in one platform, so brands can recognize and reward customers as individuals and keep them coming back. With the power of our technology and data, brands create financial products that their customers’ use everyday, earning more of their spend and increasing loyalty. Customers are rewarded with money and time saved, and surprised and delighted with a more unique, tailored experience.

We first proved our business in co-brand credit cards. For decades, the same few banks dominated the industry, building brands’ programs on mainframes older than the internet. We took a different approach, rebuilding the technology from the ground up. Today, Imprint has more than two million members, with partners like Shell, Kroger, H-E-B, and Booking.com representing half a trillion dollars in total US consumer spend. Now, we’re growing our partnerships, bringing on more members, and expanding beyond credit cards so that brands offer more ways to pay and be rewarded to recognize their customers as individuals no matter their income or preferences.

Better yet, we’re doing it differently with a lean team of the most talented people on earth. Historically, companies scaled by adding people. Imprint is taking on our opportunity with a small team of exceptional people, with the best AI and technology dramatically amplifying what each person can accomplish. That means you’ll learn faster here than you could anywhere else. You’ll be one of the few people building an entirely new technology with the ownership and trust to shape what Imprint becomes. You’ll work alongside people who make you sharper everyday, armed with tools that turn your best ideas into reality faster than you thought possible. This is a rare chance to do the most important work of your career and to help prove that a small team can build what’s never been done before, inside industries that haven’t changed in decades.

Role Summary

The Marketing Operations Specialist is an execution-focused role and our in-house Braze expert, responsible for turning marketing campaign plans into live, multi-channel communications. This role owns day-to-day campaign implementation in Braze, including the data connections that power it, and ensures timely, accurate delivery of customer communications across email, push, in-app and SMS for multiple brand partners at once.

The ideal candidate is a detail-oriented Braze power user who can spot gaps in campaign specs before launch, keeps data flowing cleanly into Braze, and communicates proactively when information is incomplete or timelines are at risk. We're automating campaign workflows, so this person will bring hands-on experience with Braze’s AI capabilities, and a builder's mindset for turning manual work into automated, AI-powered workflows.

This role reports to the Marketing team and works closely with Marketing, Analytics, Product, and Engineering partners.

What Success Looks Like in the First 90 Days

  • Delivered all assigned campaigns on time, across multiple partner programs, with zero customer-facing quality issues

  • Demonstrated mastery of Braze Canvas and campaign setup, audience configuration, Liquid personalization, and QA workflows

  • Took ownership of Braze Cloud Data Ingestion (CDI) and data connections, so audiences and attributes stay accurate and up to date

  • Raised incomplete or unclear campaign requirements proactively, preventing last-minute rework

  • Built confidence across stakeholders and partners that campaigns will launch correctly and on schedule

  • Improved efficiency in the intake-to-launch pipeline by identifying and fixing process friction, including at least one improvement to QA or communication workflows

  • Automated at least one manual campaign workflow using BrazeAI Operator, Braze's agentic features, or other AI tools, with a clear before-and-after on time saved or errors reduced

Responsibilities

  • Own day-to-day execution of multi-channel campaigns and Canvases in Braze, across email, push notifications, in-app messages, and SMS

  • Strong familiarity with Braze Cloud Data Ingestion (CDI) syncs and data connections with our data warehouse, monitoring for failures and making sure audience data and attributes are accurate

  • Translate campaign briefs into live Braze configurations, ensuring audience setup, timing, Liquid personalization, content, and tracking are correct

  • Run campaigns for multiple brand partners at the same time, keeping each partner's programs, requirements, and timelines organized

  • Conduct pre-launch QA to catch errors in copy, design, segmentation, or disclosure requirements

  • Partner with Analytics and Data teams to validate audience logic and campaign incrementality setups

  • Manage campaign delivery timelines and communicate trade-offs when new requests affect existing commitments

  • Flag incomplete or incorrect campaign inputs and work with stakeholders to resolve them before launch

  • Use Jira to track campaign requests, surface blockers, and keep status communication clear

  • Support urgent or time-sensitive communications, including incident-related customer outreach

  • Contribute to process improvements and Braze best practices that increase throughput, reduce errors, and improve stakeholder clarity

  • Use BrazeAI Operator and Braze's Agentic Standards and Operator capabilities to automate campaign build, QA and reporting workflows, and keep finding new ways to make work faster and more reliable

Qualifications

Required

  • 5+ years of experience in marketing operations, lifecycle marketing, CRM, or similar execution-focused marketing roles

  • Deep, hands-on Braze expertise: Canvas and campaign setup, audience segmentation, Liquid, A/B testing, and integrations with data systems

  • Experience managing Braze data connections, such as Cloud Data Ingestion (CDI), Currents, or warehouse syncs

  • Experience supporting multiple partners, clients, or brands at the same time, such as in an agency or multi-brand environment

  • Demonstrated attention to detail, with a track record of launching error-free customer communications

  • Ability to use data tools such as Snowflake or similar platforms to validate audience queries and attributes

  • Clear, proactive communicator who flags incomplete information and potential risks before they become issues

  • Proven ability to manage competing priorities and deliver on committed timelines

  • Experience working in cross-functional environments with Marketing, Analytics, Product, and Engineering teams

  • Experience with, or a demonstrated ability to quickly master, Braze's Agentic Standards and AI features (such as BrazeAI Operator), plus a track record of automating manual workflows with AI tools

Nice to Have

  • Braze certification

  • Experience with SendGrid, Statsig, or similar experimentation and email delivery platforms

  • Background in regulated industries (financial services, healthcare, etc.) where disclosure and compliance requirements are critical, plus familiarity with CAN-SPAM, CCPA, etc.

  • Familiarity with fintech, consumer finance, or payments marketing

  • Exposure to lifecycle marketing strategies and customer journey orchestration

Perks & Benefits

  • Competitive compensation and equity

  • Medical plan options fully paid by Imprint, including coverage for your dependents

  • 100% company-paid dental and vision plan options

  • Mental health support through Spring Health, plus a confidential Employee Assistance Program

  • Healthcare navigation through Rightway, plus HSA, FSA and commuter benefits

  • Flexible paid time off

  • 20 weeks of paid parental leave for primary caregivers and 8 weeks for all new parents

  • The latest tools and technology, including AI, so you can do your best work

Imprint is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Imprint is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status. Imprint welcomes talented individuals from all backgrounds who want to build the future of payments and rewards. If you are passionate about FinTech and eager to grow, let’s move the world forward, together.
